title: The Journey
coreMove: Treat the one-thing discipline as a continuing path of repeated choices rather than a finished achievement.
sourcePressure: Part 3 closes by treating one-thing discipline as an ongoing journey and lived practice, not a neat finish line or vague uplift.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Ending with vague inspiration, a tidy recap, or a brand-new framework.

hook: A single choice changes the whole day
The real priority is hiding under the busy work
The Journey as a generic focus opener
counterintuition: Focus is harder than it looks
tryThisNow: Set a timer and list priorities
Write down your one thing without a concrete context
examples: generic office worker choosing email or strategy

exampleSpecs.domain: community health worker after a successful vaccination drive
exampleSpecs.stakes: the next neighborhood has different barriers
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she closes the final report, opens the next street map, and writes the one first visit that keeps the practice moving
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a vaccination cooler tag beside a fresh street map with one address circled

exampleSpecs.stakes: maintenance will decide whether the project lasts
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he watches the ribbon fall, then pins the first maintenance walk to next Friday instead of treating opening day as the finish
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a cut ribbon lying on damp boardwalk planks beside a maintenance clipboard

exampleSpecs.stakes: attendance depends on ordinary Tuesdays after the celebration
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she thanks the room, then asks who owns the next Tuesday key because the journey is the next meeting
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a brass room key passed across a circle of folding chairs

exampleSpecs.domain: apprentice electrician after passing license exam
exampleSpecs.stakes: bad habits can start once supervision ends
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he puts the license in his wallet and keeps the same morning code check for the first solo job
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a fresh electrician license beside a scuffed code book in a van console

exampleSpecs.domain: archive digitization project after first collection goes live
exampleSpecs.stakes: public launch can hide unfinished preservation work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she sees the journey continues when she schedules the next fragile box before reading praise emails
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a white archival box labeled next beside a public launch screenshot

exampleSpecs.domain: neighborhood bakery after surviving its first year
exampleSpecs.stakes: anniversary attention can pull focus from the product that kept customers returning
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she predicts celebration planning deserves the week, then writes the next dough-quality test that keeps the craft alive
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a one-year candle beside a torn dough test sheet on a floury counter

skillTargets: choose the next step after a win or miss
avoid treating focus as a completed project

tryThisNowSpec: Choose the next one-thing decision you will meet this week and write the first cue that will remind you to keep practicing.
